text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the U.A.F. test tournament has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you seem full of fighting spirit 
yourself, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Elfie, along with the other contestants, 
have polished their skills for today.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
First, I will strive to run this "test 
tournament" in a way that makes it 
fruitful for all participating athletes.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Today's tournament is scheduled to be 
streamed in real time.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
As the management, we are also looking 
forward to a thrilling, white-knuckle 
competition, so please do your best.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
All the competitors are fired up! And of 
course, I'm burning with passion too!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
First of all, let's have fun today! And 
let's all make it through safely together!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting fired up once more with <chrname>, we head 
into the test tournament—!!
